title: Wizard in Study
description: A hooded wizard in purple robes sits at a green wooden desk, writing with a quill in an open book. The scene is filled with magical items including a glowing blue spiral potion bottle on a shelf, a hanging brass lantern, scrolls with wax seals, glass jars, and a framed painting of a swirling green vortex hanging on a purple wall.
prompt: A hooded wizard wearing purple and green robes sits on a stool at a long green wooden desk, writing with a quill in an open book. On the desk are scrolls with red wax seals, glass jars, and a small knife. A glowing blue spiral seashell-shaped potion bottle sits on a wooden shelf behind him next to a framed painting of a swirling green vortex. A brass lantern hangs on the left casting warm light, the room has deep purple walls with floating sparkles, fantasy illustration style, detailed, atmospheric lighting
